name: scriptorium-free
description: Lets the Scriptorium Memorialium page reach free AI models (text, pictures, speech) and FreeLLMAPI from inside the Claude app, and keeps your API keys safe on this computer across updates.
long_description: The Scriptorium page inside the Claude app may not contact outside addresses, so its free-model modes could not run there. This extension makes those requests from your own computer: the page passes it a request to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and reads the answer back as it streams. It only calls https addresses ending in /models or /chat/completions, and servers on this computer (FreeLLMAPI's image, speech and transcription endpoints among them), and, only to fetch a picture a generator returned as a link, https addresses whose answer is an image. Your keys stay in the page's own storage and pass through here only on their way to their provider.
